topography.project_purpose: Services. Structurally: 85 project-authored contract(s) across 4 chain(s); 3 ERC20 tokens, 2 ERC721 NFTs; upgradeable via ERC1967/UUPS proxies; built on openzeppelin.
topography.relationship_narrative: The protocol comprises 8 functional families. Its contracts share 8 common project-authored base contract(s) (arbitrable, realitioarbitratorwithappealsbase, idisputeresolver). Dominant framework: openzeppelin.
